headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 989 points while Nifty fell below 25,650 dragged by IT stocks and HDFC Bank.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Heavy selling pressure gripped the market in the last trading session on November 27.
IT stocks and HDFC Bank dragged down equity benchmarks during Friday's trade.
Bears took firm control after a brief rally seen in earlier sessions.
Investors locked in gains following previous foreign fund inflow-driven momentum.
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled 989 points to close at 25,600 levels on the last trading day.
Nifty slipped below the 25,650 mark amid broad-based profit taking.
RBI increased scrutiny on gold loans due to borrower stress caused by bullion market movements.
Bombay High Court permitted the Tata Sons board meeting scheduled for November 30 to proceed.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices suffered steep losses with the Sensex sinking 989 points. Weakness in IT stocks and HDFC Bank weighed heavily on market sentiment. Equity markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, November 30.
